title: Psychedelic Mouse & Beetle Dog
description: A surreal psychedelic scene on black background features a detailed brown mouse sitting on a large yellow lily pad in the lower left, with concentric ripples around it. To the right, a vibrant multicolored dog with orange, pink, green and blue fur appears within a cracked white circular frame, above which floats a large stylized eye with a spiral pupil surrounded by colorful zodiac symbols and swirling patterns. In the center background is a black pyramid with small white figures performing a ceremony.
